scale: draw at an integer scale with image-rendering: pixelated

row_panel.css: border-image: url(row_panel.png) 6 fill / calc(6px * var(--px)) repeat;

icon_box.css: border-image: url(icon_box.png) 12 fill / calc(12px * var(--px)) repeat;
icon_box.use: square well for an item icon (~40x40)

button_gold.css: border-image: url(button_gold.png) 6 fill / calc(6px * var(--px)) repeat;

button_gold_hot.css: border-image: url(button_gold_hot.png) 6 fill / calc(6px * var(--px)) repeat;

speech_bubble.css: border-image: url(speech_bubble.png) 6 fill / calc(6px * var(--px)) stretch;
speech_bubble.use: speech bubble; the tail (down-left) lives in the bottom-left corner slice, so it never repeats. The body's bottom outline is 3 px above the canvas bottom, so the bubble's visible box ends 3 px (x scale) above the element box.

prestige_panel.css: border-image: url(prestige_panel.png) 12 fill / calc(12px * var(--px)) repeat;
prestige_panel.use: whole 이직 sheet: cream offer-letter paper with a gold double-line border; small red seal in the bottom-right corner slice (never repeats); flat paper centre #e2d5b5 for dark text

prestige_card_plain.css: border-image: url(prestige_card_plain.png) 10 fill / calc(10px * var(--px)) repeat;

costume_panel.css: border-image: url(costume_panel.png) 12 fill / calc(12px * var(--px)) repeat;
costume_panel.use: hero wardrobe sheet: dark polished wood frame with gold coat-hook ornaments in the four corner slices; flat dark red velvet centre #7a0e19 (dark, use light text)

costume_row.css: border-image: url(costume_row.png) 10 fill / calc(10px * var(--px)) repeat;

costume_button.css: border-image: url(costume_button.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

apartment_panel.use: apartment sheet: light honey-wood trim around warm beige wallpaper, a tiny wooden door inside the bottom-right corner slice; flat beige centre #d2be99 (light, use dark text)

apartment_row.css: border-image: url(apartment_row.png) 10 fill / calc(10px * var(--px)) repeat;
apartment_row.use: apartment list row: cream card with a honey-wood edge and rounded corners; flat cream centre #eddfc2 (light, use dark text)

apartment_button.css: border-image: url(apartment_button.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

relics_panel.use: memento cabinet sheet: dark mahogany frame with brass corner plates and a small glass shine in the top-left corner slice; flat dark glass centre #321717 (dark, use light text). The brass corner plates stick out 1 px past the wood, so every edge has a 1 px transparent margin

relics_row.css: border-image: url(relics_row.png) 10 fill / calc(10px * var(--px)) repeat;

relics_button.css: border-image: url(relics_button.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

relics_button_hot.css: border-image: url(relics_button_hot.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

office_panel.css: border-image: url(office_panel.png) 12 fill / calc(12px * var(--px)) repeat;

office_row.css: border-image: url(office_row.png) 10 fill / calc(10px * var(--px)) repeat;
office_row.use: office list row: thin steel frame with a paperclip on the top-left corner slice (it rises 3 px above the frame top, rows 0-2 are transparent elsewhere); flat dark green centre #446951 (dark, use light text)

office_button.css: border-image: url(office_button.png) 8 8 11 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) calc(8px * var(--px)) calc(11px * var(--px)) calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;
office_button.use: office action button: chunky grey keyboard keycap (top face + front bevel); the bottom slice is 11 px because the front bevel lives there; flat top face #b9b9bd (dark text)

office_button_hot.css: border-image: url(office_button_hot.png) 8 8 11 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) calc(8px * var(--px)) calc(11px * var(--px)) calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

missions_panel.css: border-image: url(missions_panel.png) 12 fill / calc(12px * var(--px)) repeat;
missions_panel.use: whole 미션 sheet: brown wooden clipboard with a steel clip in the top-left corner slice (it rises 2 px above the board, so rows 0-1 are transparent elsewhere); cream paper centre #f1e5c3 with 1 px ruled lines every 6 rows (#cfb895), period 6 so it repeats cleanly (light, use dark text)

missions_row.css: border-image: url(missions_row.png) 10 fill / calc(10px * var(--px)) repeat;
missions_row.use: mission row: cream checklist note with an empty checkbox in the top-left corner slice, a ruled line along the bottom and a dog-ear in the bottom-right corner; flat cream centre #f1e5c3 (dark text)

missions_button.css: border-image: url(missions_button.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

missions_button_hot.css: border-image: url(missions_button_hot.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

ranking_panel.css: border-image: url(ranking_panel.png) 12 fill / calc(12px * var(--px)) repeat;

ranking_button_hot.css: border-image: url(ranking_button_hot.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

settings_panel.css: border-image: url(settings_panel.png) 12 fill / calc(12px * var(--px)) repeat;
settings_panel.use: whole 설정 sheet: matte charcoal control-panel plastic with a screw in each corner and a tiny green LED in the top-right corner slice; flat dark centre #2d313c (light text)

settings_row.css: border-image: url(settings_row.png) 10 fill / calc(10px * var(--px)) repeat;
settings_row.use: settings row: recessed charcoal switch strip with an inner shadow at the top and a lighter lip along the bottom; flat centre #2d313c (light text)

settings_button.css: border-image: url(settings_button.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

settings_button_hot.css: border-image: url(settings_button_hot.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

story_panel.css: border-image: url(story_panel.png) 12 fill / calc(12px * var(--px)) repeat;
story_panel.use: whole 스토리 sheet: comic-book cover, cream paper with a bold 2 px black ink border and halftone-dot triangles in each corner slice; flat cream centre #f5eddb (light, use dark text)

story_row.css: border-image: url(story_row.png) 10 fill / calc(10px * var(--px)) repeat;

story_button.css: border-image: url(story_button.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;
story_button.use: story action button: white comic speech bubble; the small tail lives in the bottom-left corner slice (x 4-7), the body ends 3 px above the canvas bottom, so rows 21-23 are transparent elsewhere; flat white centre #ffffff (dark text)

story_button_hot.css: border-image: url(story_button_hot.png) 8 fill / calc(8px * var(--px)) repeat;

hp_bar.draw: empty (full width) -> fill (clip width to value) -> frame on top; stretch the middle column horizontally

progress_bar.draw: empty (full width) -> fill (clip width to value) -> frame on top; stretch the middle column horizontally

red_dot.use: notification dot on an icon corner (replaces the CSS-drawn dot); draw at an integer scale
